text:
A man stands on the ground.
Which action will increase the pressure that the man exerts on the ground?
A
The man slowly bends his knees.
B
The man slowly lies down on the ground.
C
The man slowly raises his arms.
D
The man slowly raises one foot off the ground.

options.label: A
options.text: The man slowly bends his knees.

options.label: B
options.text: The man slowly lies down on the ground.

options.label: C
options.text: The man slowly raises his arms.

options.label: D
options.text: The man slowly raises one foot off the ground.
